operational_role_context: The Customer interacts with the Express Online Groceries Delivery system to browse, select, and purchase groceries.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: Customer initiates an account and logs in to the system, which retrieves their customer profile and session information. They then browse the product catalog.
Customer searches the catalog for specific items. The system filters the products based on the search criteria and displays relevant options.
Customer selects a product from the search results and adds it to their shopping cart. The shopping cart object is updated to reflect the selected products.
Customer navigates through the shopping cart and checks the availability of products. The system updates the shopping cart with the latest stock information.
Customer selects delivery options, including delivery address, and confirms the order. The system updates the delivery details and order status.
Customer processes payment through a secure payment gateway. The system confirms the payment and updates the payment status.
Customer receives a confirmation message and can track the order status through the system.
Customer provides feedback on their purchase. The system collects this feedback and updates the customer profile.

operational_role_context: The DeliveryAgent is responsible for delivering groceries to customers.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: DeliveryAgent receives a new order from the system. The system sends delivery details and order status updates to the DeliveryAgent.
DeliveryAgent checks the customer's address and coordinates with the logistics team to arrange the delivery. The system updates the delivery status with the latest status information.
DeliveryAgent arrives at the customer's address and confirms the delivery. The system updates the delivery status and sends a confirmation message to the customer.
DeliveryAgent tracks the order status and updates the system with any changes during the delivery process. The system sends notifications to the customer about any delivery updates.

operational_role_context: The PaymentProcessor processes financial transactions for Express Online Groceries Delivery.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: Customer initiates a payment through the payment gateway. The system confirms the payment and updates the payment status.
PaymentProcessor receives payment details from the payment gateway. The system processes the payment and confirms the transaction.
PaymentProcessor sends a confirmation message to the customer and updates the system with the payment status.

operational_role_context: The InventoryManager manages product inventory for Express Online Groceries Delivery.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: Successful delivery of products is noted by the DeliveryAgent. The system updates inventory levels based on the delivery details.
InventoryManager receives inventory updates from the DeliveryAgent. The system updates the inventory levels and sends notifications to stakeholders about low or out-of-stock products.

operational_role_context: The SupplierManager manages supplier information and performance.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: SupplierManager receives order details from the system. The system updates supplier information based on the order fulfillment process.
SupplierManager facilitates communication with suppliers for order fulfillment. The system sends communication details and updates supplier performance metrics.

operational_role_context: The NotificationService sends notifications to customers and suppliers.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: Customer receives order confirmation and delivery updates from the system. The system sends notifications to the customer.
SupplierManager receives order updates from the system. The system sends notifications to the supplier regarding order fulfillment and status updates.

operational_role_context: The OrderFulfillmentManager manages order creation and fulfillment, with the system providing order details and updates.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: OrderFulfillmentManager receives order details from the system and updates the order state with delivery and payment details.

OrderFulfillmentManager coordinates with InventoryManager to ensure product availability and coordinates orders with the system for fulfillment. The system updates the order state with delivery status and payment status.
In case of customer escalation, the OrderFulfillmentManager overrides its automated processes to address the escalation in terms of order fulfillment.

operational_role_context: The SystemAdministrator manages the Express Online Groceries Delivery system.

chronological_milestones_and_data_inputs.data_object_layer: SystemAdministrator accesses system configurations and logs to monitor system performance and security. The system administrator updates system configurations and handles user account access management.
